truth_rule: Proof assumptions, explicit derivations, executed checks and source scope determine verdicts; no majority vote.

claims.title: Finite-model global forward existence
claims.statement: Every admissible finite initial state has a unique solution for all finite forward times under the stated global positive Z margin.
assumptions: Finite fixed positive masses and weights; finite real canonical momenta
evidence: round5/theorem_advisor.md T1-T14: norm conservation, U>=0, Wprime=xF, epsilon-regularized bound, compact continuation
round5/proof_critique.md: independent proof and hypothesis-deletion counterexamples
claims.skeptic_objection: Energy positivity depends on state admissibility and positive weights; bounded electric field alone is insufficient without a bound on a on each finite interval.
unresolved_obligations: Derive the physical closure from a common continuum prescription
Prove dynamical cutoff convergence separately
No all-time bound on a or raw tangent for general pure-state data
claims.review_method: Independent derivation/scope review; agreement between agents is not the acceptance criterion.
